title: Cookie management feature
body:
At work, I find myself having to go to cookie management page to remove cookies from a specific domain or from multiple domains. I would love to have this feature added to SurfingKeys.

I'm thinking of working on this myself but I wanted to check with you @brookhong and with the users. I am planning to add the command `:RemoveCookies` which takes a Regex and will remove any cookie with the domain matching it. But for that to work, we would have to grant the `cookies` permission, that'll prompt the extension users to re-approve the extension, but given that most users are tech savvy, I think that'd be fine.

Please vote.
author: Participant 1
